name: duopore-public-owner-factual-response-draft
description: Draft replies to property questions using answers the owner has actually given.

interface.longDescription: Draft replies to property questions using answers the owner has actually given. Share each question, the owner's answer and whether it is confirmed. Get a draft you can review. Unconfirmed answers stay as requests to check the facts, instead of being stated as true. The app does not send replies or provide legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Draft replies from these confirmed owner answers.
Keep unconfirmed property answers as questions to check.
